title: Blue Account at a glance
summary: “Blue Account at a glance” lists: $20.00 monthly maintenance fee, waived with a minimum daily balance of $625, 1% out-of-network ATM fee (max $3.00), 0.01% interest, $2,500 daily mobile check deposit limit, and early direct deposit 1 day(s) before payday; no overdraft fees.
